experiment_data.hypothesis: CKA-only pruned models exhibit significantly stronger gradient signals (per-layer L2 norm) compared to Standard and RASP, with statistical significance (Wilcoxon p<0.05). This gradient magnitude difference is consistent with CKA-only's superior GRPO recovery capacity.
